reason: TalentWerx self-describes as "a talent acquisition firm" (talentwerx.io/about-talentwerx) and is listed as a Staffing and Recruiting company, now a division of EXPANSIA under PE-backed roll-up Aether Aerospace (JHNA + CTSi + EXPANSIA, backed by Falfurrias Management Partners) — the Lever board is a recruiter's req board, its JDs say "Our client is seeking...", and the real hiring entity is a multi-entity PE platform, not an independent 8-30 person Series A/B defense startup, so it fails both the staffing-firm ban and the wrong-side-of-market ban.
